english.title: Falsely pretend to be merchant shipping inspector / surveyor / authorised officer under ship and ports regulations
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) falsely pretended to be

(A)_[an inspector appointed under section 256 of the Merchant Shipping Act 1995]_
(B)_[a surveyor appointed under section 256 of the Merchant Shipping Act 1995]_
(C)_[an 'authorised person' within the meaning of section 46(1) of the Aviation and Maritime Security Act 1990]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 12(1)(b) and (3) of the Ship and Port Facility (Security) Regulations 2004.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

Note
Note that for offences committed since 12 March 2015, section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012 removes the limits on certain fines given by the Magistrates' Courts. Offences that were previously punishable by fines of 'prescribed sums' and that were limited to 'not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale' or 'not exceeding the statutory maximum', are now punishable by a fine of any amount.
